elements.element: Commercial general liability USD 1M per occurrence
elements.evidence: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence
professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000
cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000

elements.element: Workers' compensation as required by law
elements.evidence: workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law
shall provide Client with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage on request

elements.element: Vendor is the insured party maintaining coverage
elements.evidence: TrueLink shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement
professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000
cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000

reasons: All preferred atomic elements are expressly present: CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber/privacy 5M, statutory workers' compensation, and certificates on request, with TrueLink as the obligated insured.

The insertion is a concise new clause for an absent topic and does not disturb the Force Majeure paragraph or any other term; no undefined terms or dangling mechanics are introduced (Client and TrueLink are defined).

Minimality is marginally exceeded: the preferred position calls for coverage limits and certificates, not a one-year post-termination coverage tail; 'and for one (1) year thereafter' adds a substantive obligation beyond the locked target level and should be dropped (or the coverage period left as the term) if strict minimality is required.
'at its own expense' is ordinary, non-substantive drafting glue and is not treated as an offending addition.
